title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornography was created and posted on a platform without any system to detect or prevent nonconsensual intimate imagery. The videos targeted multiple well-known women including politicians, athletes, and television presenters. The deployment failure was the absence of content moderation or technical safeguards to block such material before it reached the platform's thirteen million monthly visitors.

The system that created the deepfakes operated without human oversight or consent from the people depicted. It was deployed to produce material that is illegal in the jurisdiction where the victims are located. Technical detection of manipulated media, human review before publication, or age-gating systems could have prevented distribution.

Whether the platform operator knew about the illegal content or took deliberate steps to host it is not established by the reporting.

summary:
Multiple female Dutch celebrities are considering legal action after discovering themselves in manipulated pornographic videos posted on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature various well-known figures, including television presenters, Olympic athletes, government ministers, and members of the royal family. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and encouraged victims to file reports. Several managers and representatives confirmed that victims have either filed complaints or are exploring legal options.

Deepfake pornography, where a person's face is digitally placed onto explicit content, is classified as revenge porn and therefore illegal. Legal experts advise victims to file police reports, which may allow prosecutors to shut down websites hosting such material. Other options include filing mass claims, complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. This follows a previous case where television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma pursued legal action against a 39-year-old man from Amersfoort, who received a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
